findings.summary: KernelCoordinator._requests_for drops a DD result input whenever last_turn_report is present because the DD review and gate-wake branches use if/elif. The SPEC requires enroll, message, steer, DD result, and DD review inputs to enter the single durable queue independently. In a round containing both a DD review report and dd_awaiting_gate_development_id, the gate-wake request is never persisted or delivered, so an accepted DD input is silently lost and the corresponding Goal call never occurs.
